property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.policy.rest.url
property.description: MANDATORY: comma-separated URL(s) of the Ranger admin instance(s).

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.access.cluster.name
property.description: Cluster name recorded in audit logs generated by the plugin.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.use.rangerGroups
property.description: Whether user-to-group mapping is obtained from Ranger.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.use.only.rangerGroups
property.description: true: only Ranger groups; false: Ranger + Trino groups.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.super.users
property.description: Users authorized for all accesses without explicit policy grants.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.super.groups
property.description: Groups authorized for all accesses without explicit policy grants.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.ugi.initialize
property.description: Initialize a Kerberos identity to authenticate with Ranger admin. Off for the laptop subset.
